cards.t: SkyAI Liquidates Solana Treasury for $201M Buyback
cards.b: SkyAI has sold all of its SOL holdings and launched a $201 million buyback program to repurchase shares and warrants using its $223.8 million cash holdings.

per.SOL: Treasury firm SkyAI has completely sold off its SOL holdings.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST
cards.missing: The exact execution schedule for the share repurchase.

cards.b: Solana's Alpenglow, its biggest network overhaul since 2020, went live on Wednesday to replace its legacy voting system, targeting 150-millisecond finality.

per.SOL: Alpenglow launch replaces the voting system used since 2020 to achieve faster finality.

cards.label: COMPLETED CATALYST
cards.missing: Exact time of day for the rollout beyond Wednesday.
